name: maple_parity
label: maple_parity
description: Cross-backend Maple sanity + decode bench. Same messages for rMLX and mlx-lm. Greedy (temp=0), thinking ON, FlashHead OFF, KV bf16. Demand a long structured answer so generation crosses the SWA-512 ring. Checkable tokens: RINGS=/UNBOUNDED= in S1, eight ## S# headings, closing TITLES: line.
notes: Fairness: maple must run --no-flash-head (rMLX has no FlashHead). Token identity is greedy argmax of the exact lm_head. Thinking is part of the stream; compare both full token ids and the post-</think> body. max_tokens 768 is enough for think + ~400-word body; raise to 1024 if think eats the budget. Do not bind rMLX to :8080.

messages.content: You are a careful systems engineer writing a design note. Follow the output contract exactly. Use the facts given; do not invent hardware numbers. After thinking, the visible answer must be long, technical, and structured as specified — no preamble before S1, no apology, no extra sections.

Write a design note for a single-process inference engine that serves one hybrid transformer:

Facts you must treat as ground truth (do not “correct” them):
- 24 decoder layers, hidden 2048, GQA 16 query / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128.
- layer_types repeat [sliding, sliding, sliding, full] so the stack is 3 sliding-window layers then 1 full-attention layer, repeating.
- Sliding-window size is 512 tokens. Sliding layers apply partial RoPE (64 of 128 dims, traditional=false, theta=10000). Full-attention layers are NoPE (no RoPE).
- Every layer is sparse MoE: 256 experts, top-8, expert FFN width 512, no shared expert, first_k_dense_replace=0.
- Router is fp32 softmax then top-8 then renormalize. Expert SwiGLU is clamped: silu(min(gate, 7)) * clip(up, -7, 7).
- Weights are affine 2-bit with one row_alpha per output row (embed/lm_head are 4-bit g64). There is an exact lm_head and also an optional approximate FlashHead; this engine uses the exact head only.
- KV: rotating ring of max 512 on sliding layers; unbounded cache on full layers. Prompt-cache reuse is Exact-only because a rotating ring cannot be rebuilt from a truncated prefix.
- Decode is greedy (temperature 0). Thinking tags are <think> and </think>; the chat template opens think on generation.

Compute, then use, these two integers (they are determined by the facts above):
- How many layers have a rotating KV ring?
- How many layers have an unbounded KV cache?
Write them in S1 as the exact tokens RINGS=<n> and UNBOUNDED=<n> on their own line.

Output contract for the visible answer (after </think>):
1. Exactly eight sections, in this order, each starting with a markdown heading on its own line:
   ## S1 Inventory
   ## S2 Ring occupancy
   ## S3 Prefill versus decode
   ## S4 MoE routing
   ## S5 Quantization and the exact head
   ## S6 Failure modes
   ## S7 Cross-layer coupling
   ## S8 Operational checklist
2. Each of S1–S6 and S8 must contain at least four full sentences (not fragments). S7 must contain at least six full sentences and must quote, in double quotes, one complete sentence copied verbatim from your S2 body (not the heading).
3. After S2’s sentences, include a markdown table with header `| Layer class | Window | RoPE | Cache |` and exactly two data rows: sliding and full.
4. After S4’s sentences, include a fenced rust code block (```rust) of 16–24 lines that sketches `fn select_experts(logits: &[f32; 256], k: usize) -> ([u16; 8], [f32; 8])` with a comment that scores are fp32 and renormalized. The function may be a sketch; it must compile in spirit (valid-looking Rust).
5. S6 must name at least these four faults, each in a sentence: NaN prefill logits, FlashHead cluster miss, prefix-cache reuse of a rotating ring, bf16 router flipping a near-tied top-8.
6. S8 must be a numbered list 1–8 of operational invariants. Item 3 must mention idle unload wiping weights and KV. Item 7 must mention a single Metal context per process.
7. After S8, one final line and nothing else:
   TITLES: S1 Inventory | S2 Ring occupancy | S3 Prefill versus decode | S4 MoE routing | S5 Quantization and the exact head | S6 Failure modes | S7 Cross-layer coupling | S8 Operational checklist

Constraints:
- Do not add a ninth section. Do not put a title before S1.
- Do not enable FlashHead. If you discuss it, only as a disabled approximation.
- Do not claim CUDA or GGUF. Apple Silicon, MLX-format weights, one process.
- The note should be long: aim for roughly 500–700 words in the visible answer, not counting the table, the code block, or the TITLES line.
- If a fact above conflicts with common LLM lore, the facts win.
